sonnet.problem: The line 'the nations will know that I am the LORD' (39:7) is the same refrain already asked about on card 8 (39:6), and it appears again in 39:22 and 39:28. This card asks about it a second time.
sonnet.rule: When a line repeats in the passage, like a psalm's refrain, ask about it only the first time it appears in this passage.

sonnet.problem: This card asks who will know that He is the LORD their God (39:22). The refrain 'they will know that I am the LORD' was already asked about in stop 1 (cards 8 and 9), so this is a repeat.
sonnet.rule: When a line repeats in the passage, like a psalm's refrain, ask about it only the first time it appears in this passage.

sonnet.problem: Card 11 says Israel will 'kindle fires and burn up the weapons', and the question repeats 'burn up Gog's weapons'. Together they give away 'fuel for fires' and rule out the wrong answers 'tools for farming' and 'tribute for kings'.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.
